title: "exports is not defined" `ReferenceError` in AMD output
body:
### Rollup Version

4.40.0

### Operating System (or Browser)

macOS

### Node Version (if applicable)

_No response_

### Link To Reproduction

https://rollupjs.org/repl/?version=4.40.0&

### Expected Behaviour

The special AMD 'exports' module is added if `output.exports` is 'named' and then the error does not occur, but since this is using 'auto', it should either not be using `exports` at all, and should return the value directly, or it should add the 'exports' module in 'auto' mode too since it does use `return exports.default;` at the end.

### Actual Behaviour

See line 37 in above test output. The repl is a copy of https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/master/test/form/samples/deconflict-format-specific-globals/main.js

The repl output is the same at:
 https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/1f2d579ccd4b39f223fed14ac7d031a6c848cd80/test/form/samples/deconflict-format-specific-globals/_expected/amd.js#L37
